name: folder
description: A rounded folder silhouette with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Original rounded outer contour preserves the folder tab and is drawn once. The contour bounds are x=3..21 and y=3..21: at the unchanged 1.75 stroke, visible padding is exactly 2.125 units on all four sides of the 24-unit viewBox. The front-panel upper edge is one straight horizontal stroke at y=10, without retracing the sides or bottom. Lower corners use matching 2.5-unit construction. Existing body/lid part names, stroke defaults and motion recipe are retained for this static review.
